units.source_text: 夕雾来到外祖母太君那里，但见外祖母正在静静地修行佛法。

en.t: Yugiri came to his grandmother, the Ta君, and saw that she was quietly devoting herself to Buddhist practice.

units.source_text: 也有许多姣好的青年侍女在这里服侍，

en.t: Many attractive young serving women were also in attendance there,

units.source_text: 但姿态、相貌和服装等，都比不上兴盛的六条院里的众侍女。

en.t: but in bearing, looks, clothing, and the like, they could not compare with the serving women of the flourishing Rokujo estate.

units.source_text: 倒是几个相貌美丽的尼姑，

en.t: Rather, several beautiful nuns there

units.source_text: 身穿灰色衣服的消瘦姿态，与这地方十分调和，颇有幽寂之趣。

en.t: looked thin and graceful in their gray robes, perfectly suited to the place and full of a quiet, secluded charm.

units.source_text: 内大臣来参见太君了，室内点起灯来，母子二人从容晤谈。

en.t: The Inner Minister came to pay his respects to the Ta君; lamps were lit indoors, and mother and son talked at ease.

units.source_text: 太君说：“我许久不见孙女了，好苦闷啊！”

en.t: The Ta君 said, “I have not seen my granddaughter for so long. How painful it is!”

units.source_text: 说罢哭个不住。

en.t: After saying this, she wept without stopping.

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“这几天内我就叫她来参见吧。

en.t: The Inner Minister said, “I will have her come to pay her respects within the next few days.

units.source_text: 她自讨烦恼，消瘦得怪可怜的。

en.t: She has brought this distress on herself, and has grown so thin that it is truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 实在，要是能够的话，最好不生女孩。

en.t: Really, if it were possible, it would be best not to have daughters at all.

units.source_text: 处处要叫人操心呢！”

en.t: They make one worry over everything!”

units.source_text: 他说这话时怒气尚未消解，还不免耿耿于怀。

en.t: As he said this, his anger had still not subsided, and resentment remained in his heart.

units.source_text: 太君甚是伤心，也不恳切地盼望云居雁来了。

en.t: The Ta君 was deeply saddened, and no longer earnestly longed for Kumoi no Kari to come.

units.source_text: 内大臣乘便告道：“不瞒你说，最近我又找到了一个不成样子的女儿，

en.t: Taking the opportunity, the Inner Minister told her, “To be honest, I have recently found another rather troublesome daughter,

units.source_text: 弄得我没有办法呢。”

en.t: and she has left me quite at a loss.”

units.source_text: 他愁眉苦脸地说过之后，又笑起来。

en.t: After saying this with a troubled face, he began to laugh again.

units.source_text: 太君说：“哎呀，哪里有这等话！

en.t: The Ta君 said, “Oh my, how could such a thing be!

units.source_text: 既然说是你的女儿，难道会不成样子么？”

en.t: If she is said to be your daughter, how could she possibly be unworthy?”

units.source_text: 内大臣说：“正因为是我的女儿，所以教我为难。

en.t: The Inner Minister said, “It is precisely because she is my daughter that I am troubled.

units.source_text: 我总想带她来给太君看看呢。”

en.t: I have long wanted to bring her here and show her to you, Ta君.”

units.source_text: 他的话大致如此。

en.t: That was roughly what he said.
